nodes.label: Blind Tender Analysis Protocol
nodes.rationale: The shared protocol requires full-document review, visual scan inspection, OOXML control-state inspection, exactly 27 fields, grounded quotes, explicit conflicts, and safe not_found semantics.

nodes.label: tender_fields_v1 Semantic Catalog
nodes.rationale: The catalog is the human-readable semantic source of truth for exactly 27 stable field_key values across worker, aggregation, recheck, finalization, and reporting layers.

nodes.label: Client Semantics Safety Invariants
nodes.rationale: Confirmed presentation choices do not authorize inference from absence or relaxation of evidence and route guards.

nodes.label: Majority Vote Shared-Error Limit
nodes.rationale: Agreement among similar models does not protect against a systematic semantic mistake shared by all of them.

nodes.label: Safe not_found Semantics
nodes.rationale: not_found means a value could not be established after complete analysis and never implies no, not required, not applicable, or not provided.

nodes.label: Qualification Technical and Commercial Application Parts

nodes.label: Deterministic External Guards
nodes.rationale: The proposed production boundary verifies literal evidence, derived arithmetic, catalog allow/deny rules, inter-run disagreement, strict versioned JSON, and a DB-backed 27/27 barrier outside the model.

nodes.label: Isolated Codex Runner Service
nodes.rationale: A separate HTTP job runner isolates long Codex executions from n8n, limits filesystem and database authority, validates schema, and exposes queued and completed job states.

nodes.label: Codex Shadow Mode Evaluation
nodes.rationale: The proposed safe transition runs Codex independently beside the existing workflow, compares both with adjudicated truth, and keeps the old result authoritative until repeated evidence justifies switching.

nodes.label: Application Documents Completeness Contract
nodes.rationale: Field 27 requires complete retrieval of mandatory and conditional application materials before generating a concise presentation value, with conditions retained when omission would mislead.

nodes.label: Literal License Certificate Boundary
nodes.rationale: Field 22 admits only documents explicitly called a license or certificate and excludes permissions, registrations, passports, declarations, and participant registry extracts unless separately represented in application_documents.

nodes.label: Round 2 Fail Closed Route Guard
nodes.rationale: Only four field keys have field-specific Round 2 semantic rules; the other 23 must terminate as requires_review with audit and evidence preserved instead of using a generic resolver.

nodes.label: Four Run Reproducibility Evaluation
nodes.rationale: Four independent analyses used byte-identical source materials; every run returned 27 fields, while only 22 of 27 field statuses were unanimous.

nodes.label: Exec Run Completion Summary
nodes.rationale: The exec run reports all 12 documents and formats checked, with 21 resolved, 4 requires_review, and 2 not_found fields.

nodes.label: Exec Blind Analysis Result
nodes.rationale: The exec result completed the structural contract but over-escalated customer_contacts and participation_cost and resolved national_regime despite recording contradictory Russian-origin requirements.

nodes.label: Run 1 Blind Analysis Result
nodes.rationale: Run 1 preserved the national-regime conflict and used not_found for participation cost, but miscalculated the procurement quantity as 10 instead of 11 and used less precise quotations.

nodes.label: Run 1 Reproducible Analysis Process
nodes.rationale: The log records corpus inventory, OOXML extraction, PDF rendering and visual review, temporary analysis scripts, report writing, and a final automated 27-field structure check.

nodes.label: Run 2 Blind Analysis Result
nodes.rationale: Run 2 was the safest single result, with detailed structural locators and preserved conflicts, but over-escalated participation cost and still violated the field-22 boundary.

nodes.label: Run 2 Reproducible Analysis Process
nodes.rationale: The log records full DOCX and PDF analysis, ActiveX inspection, a user correction forbidding Graphify, and final validation of 27 results with a 21/4/2 status distribution.

nodes.label: Run 3 Blind Analysis Result
nodes.rationale: Run 3 correctly derived 11 units and inspected embedded XLSX and graphical controls, but resolved national_regime and application_documents even while describing their contradictions.

nodes.label: Run 3 Reproducible Analysis Process
nodes.rationale: The log records complete format inventory, full OOXML and embedded-object extraction, visual review of both PDFs, and an automated verification of 27 ordered fields and required evidence attributes.

nodes.label: Shared Licenses and Certificates Drift
nodes.rationale: All four runs widened licenses_certificates beyond documents literally named licenses or certificates, proving that majority voting cannot reveal correlated semantic errors.

nodes.label: Unresolved Conflict Guard
nodes.rationale: A field must not be resolved when its own rationale still records a material contradiction; national_regime and application_documents exposed this failure class.

nodes.label: Single Agent FINAL Acceptance Risk
nodes.rationale: All runs satisfied the 27-field shape, but random errors and shared semantic drift make one unreviewed agent run unsafe as production FINAL.

nodes.label: Two Part Advance Contract Guarantee
nodes.rationale: Field 20 must separately cover contract-performance security and advance-return security within one stable field_key; evidence for one part cannot silently close the other.

nodes.label: Whole Corpus Agent Reviewer Advantage
nodes.rationale: A whole-corpus agent can revisit sources, compare fields, inspect conflicts, and check completeness, whereas narrow workflow model calls see filtered units or candidates.

nodes.label: Early Context Loss Failure
nodes.rationale: Once an upstream worker detaches a value from its heading or assigns the wrong field_key, later validator and aggregator stages cannot reliably reconstruct the missing context.

nodes.label: Readable PDF Filename Persistence
